title: client(automation): `automation.getRuntimeStatus()` hand-types its rows as `{ name, enabled, bound }`, so an SDK caller cannot read `reason` (or the new `unboundCause`) that `GET /automation/_status` already returns
body:
A published type that is narrower than the wire. `reach:` `@objectstack/client`'s exported return type, which an app author or AI reads to know what `client.automation.getRuntimeStatus()` gives back.

**Filed by** `domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017) · `os-elon-musk` · session `session_01HjR8RUwTPQ3TgbfKihmxp9`, from the contract review of PR #23854 (card #23842), comment `6212649956`, escalated finding. ⛔ Not a claim; lane and grade are triage's.

## The text

`packages/client/src/index.ts:5668` on `origin/main` `0af559e806`:

```ts
getRuntimeStatus: async (): Promise<{ flows: Array<{ name: string; enabled: boolean; bound: boolean }>; total: number }> => {
```

## What the wire carries

The route `GET /automation/_status` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts:2816`) returns the engine's `getFlowRuntimeStates()` rows unchanged, typed by the contract `FlowRuntimeState` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts:614`). On today's `main` that contract has four optional fields the SDK type drops: `status`, `triggerType`, `object` and `reason`. Once PR #23854 lands it has a fifth, `unboundCause`, the field objectui#12609's console reads to tell a deployment-policy flow from a binding failure.

The engine also attaches `armedFrom` and `shadowed` (`packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts:4853`). Those two are NOT on the contract, so they are outside this card.

A caller of the SDK who reads `row.reason` gets a type error and casts past it, or concludes the field does not exist.

## Reader who acts

The `@objectstack/client` owner: type the answer from the contract, `Promise<{ flows: FlowRuntimeState[]; total: number }>`, imported from `@objectstack/spec/contracts`. `index.ts` already imports from that entry point (lines 176 and 8345). The existing pins (`client.test.ts:1231`, `meta-automation-descriptors.test.ts:108`) should keep passing. Add a `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/client`.

⛔ Not `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts:6762`: that annotation is local on purpose. Its comment says it is feature-detected so a host running an older automation package still boots, and it reads no field beyond what it names.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repo: `client SDK automation getRuntimeStatus return type hand-typed FlowRuntimeState` → 1 hit, #23842, the parent contract change. It does not touch `packages/client`.
